title: Rebecca E NDE 3293
content: I awoke in the light, experiencing all the emotions I had caused others to feel in my life here. This is very important and the feelings are very strong. I had almost lost my life once before and I felt the feelings my mother felt equally as other emotions great and small. Without realizing it you may be setting yourself up to feel terribly by not being considerate, by being impatient or being curt with people you don't even know or expect to see again. This to me is what Heaven and Hell is, and governs how I live my life. I was at perfect peace during and after this. I found myself in the presence of God, now understanding the Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, how He is the Word and the Word was with Him. He communicated by injecting complete thoughts into my mind, and retrieved my answers similarly. There was no spoken word, no misunderstanding and no waste of time. I did not want to come back. He instantly knew this by my extreme joy at being home and lack of interest in anything else. He let me know I had to come back. Almost the entire time I argued that the body was too broken and painful to return to. He tried to explain logically how it was possible for me to return. At the end of two weeks He showed me my children's entire lives and let me feel how they would feel if I didn't return, and by my choice I did. I slammed back into my body so hard that it moved. A nurse seeing this began running at me with the syringe she was carrying and knocked me back out with medication. It was not the same.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident liver spit in half - spleen ruptured and something to my bladder Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) had been deceased for 6 or more hours when discovered. I was there for a very long time - ruptured spleen, liver split in half and something to my bladder. The EMTs said I was gone after 20 minutes and they didn't find me for 6 hours. I had one pint of blood left.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Life on Earth is like struggling to walk through concrete compared to the ease of being in what I now call the real life.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time and space are one, as are light and emotion.
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: The vividness is related to time the way mathematics are to language. Time/distance is also solidity/transparency. Using math as language should enable this to be explained.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I don't remember sound as such. Communication was through thought injection. An entire thought was simply present at once.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes God. It was communicated to me that I was not finished and must return. Everyone living and dead was there in the spirit. Those who had returned were part of the source of the light, which is light but more so energy.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes We were part of the light and the light was God.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm yes there are levels of heaven
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Every emotion I had ever evoked from anyone else was felt as if it were happening to me. This must be the Heaven and Hell of it. I felt perfect peace, all pervading love and the sense that this was my real life (I do remember them taking my footprints when I was born and not speaking the language made me feel alienated). I do remember it felt as if I were home. I never felt that on earth.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Each emotion whether great or small was felt with the same intensity as the larger emotions. For instance, when I was 12 I almost died, and during the NDE, I felt my mother's emotions as strongly as a girl who asked me to be friends with her and I said I couldn't. The depth of the feeling was the same.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I seemed to know the next thing to happen. I often told people I had a dream more real than reality to explain, then in a couple of weeks it would happen. Very specific things: impending deaths, health issues, even foot conditions - nothing to small.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes Indeed - some of which we are not to know while we are here.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Deeper, more forgiving. Love for the sake of loving unconditionally, without expecting anything in return.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain Communication with God was by a process I've come to call thought injection, although for years was unable to describe it to my satisfaction. Responses were similar. Everyone whose life had in any way touched mine was present then as part of the whole. The 'community' of spirits were also part of the light.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Seeing spirits, past, present, knowing how something happened watching the news - even incidental things about myself, my life or others.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I haven't heard of anyone who was certain they had spoken with God.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They always treat you differently.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. It was more real than this is. At the time I was so busy with the task at hand I didn't really stop to consider it.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. This is why we come back, to describe how one thing is no more or less important than another. That it's not what we call God, but that we praise him that matters. It's all part of his design. He gives us knowledge to help ourselves and each other, not for personal gain.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I wish everyone could experience this. What a wonderful world, but we must have faith. He wants us to.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Let me think about this - you've put a lot into this.
